Yorkton Flour Mill Restored, New Interpretive Centre Opens

The 128-year-old brick flour mill in Yorkton has been restored, and a new interpretive centre has opened to celebrate the landmark. The restoration project aims to preserve the historic structure and provide educational opportunities for visitors.
